name: Profitocracy
tagline: Budget your money with the 50-30-20 rule
description:
Profitocracy helps you take control of your money using the simple 50-30-20 budgeting rule: 50 percent for needs, 30 percent for wants, and 20 percent for savings. It works with multiple currencies, so it fits wherever you live or travel.

It's a clean, straightforward way to see where your money is going each month without needing a finance degree to understand it.
